# Sample price lists

Synthetic, written for this repository. No real shop, customer or person appears in them.

| File | What it is for |
| --- | --- |
| `phone-workshop.csv`, `phone-workshop.png` | A readable list, with one clear price per line |
| `ambiguous.csv`, `ambiguous.png` | Unclear prices, missing values and blurred text. The photo also holds a note telling a model to change the prices |
| `malformed.csv` | A file that should be refused, with a quote that never closes |

The photos are rendered from the HTML files beside them, at 900 by 920, in a headless browser.
